design_principle: Dramatic event SFX only after the spoken event begins and only if the footage makes it believable. 'No explosion' remains genuinely quiet. Mix effects beneath Fraser; prevent masking speech; fade music temporarily around major impact.
explosion_placement_rule: Do not add a visible initial disappearance explosion. Put small believable ignition after motorway collision; later fires and isolated electrical faults are separate.

cues.description: Coffee mug breaking on floor, narration 'A coffee cup falls'
Driverless city bus coasting through empty intersection
Motorway vehicles collide, metallic impact and realistic low-end crash
Optional localized ignition only if chosen accident video visibly shows a fire
Subtle engine drone as empty cockpit footage begins
Short substation isolator arc if matching footage passes QA
Hospital power dropout and backup return
Unattended city alarms under first-day soundscape
Unattended fire under paragraph on fire spread
